# T-5: Route acceptance findings

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Ensure acceptance-review consumes deferred findings, decides their final disposition, and mirrors finalDisposition before final-regression.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R7 acceptance-review evidence includes deferred findings and source artifact references.
- R7 non-pass acceptance-review verdicts route through existing amend/block/user-decision paths.
- R6 finalDisposition is mirrored into flow-findings.json after acceptance-review decision.

## Implementation Notes
Use existing acceptance-review-artifacts.js and flow-findings.js helpers where possible. Do not copy full finding details into flow-findings.json.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for acceptance-review evidence building and finalDisposition mirroring; integration-level flow test if existing fixtures support it.
